data.completion_memo: Implemented root-anchored project references and immutable object filesystem publication with traversal and symlink escape checks; Git actions remain absent.
data.description: Implement project-root-anchored portable filesystem and Git-coexistence ports, a hermetic filesystem conformance adapter, descriptive read-only Git/worktree facts, and traversal/symlink/reparse/case-safe project-file references. Aworkit must not stage, commit, merge, or push. Native filesystem and durability implementations are owned by M12.1; portable artifact CAS is implemented in M06.4.
data.title: M06.2 — Implement safe portable workspace and reference adapters
